claim: Goldman Sachs Research (Feb 2024 article) put humanoid manufacturing cost at $30,000-$150,000 per unit, down from $50,000-$250,000 the year before; decline of 40% against an expected 15-20% per annum. Dated 2024; a 2026 Goldman update was not found on goldmansachs.com.

Where our analysts had expected a decline of 15-20% per annum, the cost declined 40%.
